description: List recent workflow runs (and ad-hoc traffic) for a sandbox, newest first. Use when the user asks 'what did I run', 'show me recent validation runs', 'did the stripe test pass earlier', or wants to find a previous run to share or re-inspect. Each run includes its shareable timeline URL (fetchsandbox.com/runs/<sandbox_id>) so the user can open the visual trace in a browser or drop it in Slack / a PR comment. Requires sandbox_id (from import_spec).

limit.description: Max number of runs to return (default 20, server may cap).

name: list_runs
